import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    e=np.abs(eps)
    return p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2+p[3]*np.log(T)+(p[4]+p[5]*T+p[6]*T**2+p[7]*T**3)*e**3+p[8]*e+p[9]*e**2
